title: Contents Packout & Storage Late Fee Rules
content:
Late fees on a past-due Contents Packout & Storage balance follow these rules.

## Rule

1. The job must be in invoiced status when a late fee is charged.
2. A late fee may post only after the grace period following the payment due date recorded at invoicing has fully passed.
3. The grace period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the payment due date, and the first late fee may post on the day after the grace period's last day.
4. A late fee is assessed at most once per calendar month fee period at the late fee percentage of the balance due, with the late fee minimum as a floor, rounded to the cent, half up.
5. No late fee posts on an insurance-funded (insurance claim) job while its linked claim file is in opened, estimate submitted or approved status and the suspension period counted from the invoice date has not ended.
6. Late fees are never back-dated to a suspended period, and a job with a zero or negative balance is never charged a late fee.

## Grace period count

The anchor is the payment due date recorded on the job at invoicing. Day 1 of the grace period is the day after that due date; the grace period lasts the tier's grace days (the tier figure in the product's billing office schedule); the first late fee may post on the day after the grace period's last day, not on the last day itself.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical 7-day grace period).** Payment due on the 10th of a month: grace runs from the 11th through the 17th. A late fee may not post on the 17th; it may first post on the 18th.

## Amount

The late fee for a calendar month fee period is the late fee percentage of the balance due, with the late fee minimum as a floor, rounded to the cent, half up. At most one late fee is assessed per calendar month fee period.

| Hypothetical balance due | Hypothetical percentage 2 percent | Hypothetical minimum 30.00 | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 900.00 | 18.00 | floor 30.00 | 30.00 |
| 2,250.00 | 45.00 | floor 30.00 | 45.00 |
| 0.00 or negative | — | — | no late fee |

## Suspension on insurance-funded jobs

| Job | Linked claim file status | Suspension period counted from the invoice date | Late fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| insurance-funded | opened, estimate submitted or approved | not ended | none posts |

The suspension days are the tier figure in the billing office schedule. A late fee is never back-dated to a suspended period.
